newsitem.title: USA: Lucent wins U S West wireless pact.
newsitem.headline: Lucent wins U S West wireless pact.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc. has won a $500 million contract from U S West Communications Group for a new generation of wireless communications equipment, the companies said Wednesday.
The multi-year deal could grow to more than $1 billion as U S West continues to upgrade its service, U S West said.

Lucent, a former unit of AT&T Corp. based in Murray Hill, N.J., also said it has won $178 million in additional contracts with wireless network operators in the United States and Korea to provide digital equipment.
In South Korea, Lucent said, a consortium with Hanwha Telecommunications Co. Ltd. won a $93 million contract by Hansol PCS to supply and install a digital network.
Hansol PCS, one of South Korea's three licensed nationwide Personal Communications Services operators, is a consortium led by Hansol Paper Co.

In the United States, Frontier Cellular, a unit of Frontier Corp., awarded Lucent $85 million over three years to convert wireless networks in upstate New York to digital service using its new technology, Lucent said.
Lucent's stock was up 50 cents at $58.625, while U S West was unchanged at $34.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
